text:
Suvi Lindholm will chair the Marrowgate Water Board for the coming year, following the board's annual appointments announced on 14 March 2025.

Lindholm was elected by 7 votes to 2 among the nine voting members, according to the published minutes of the Annual General Meeting, held at Marrowgate Civic Hall. The vote is recorded under Item 4, "Election of Chair."

Tobias Verhaegen, Clerk to the Marrowgate Water Board, confirmed the appointment in a written statement sent to this newspaper. "Suvi Lindholm is chair of the Marrowgate Water Board," he wrote, adding that the result was recorded in the minutes.

The Gazette has read the minutes and Mr Verhaegen's statement. The board is responsible for water services in the Marrowgate area. Lindholm takes up the post immediately.
